name: CarryTorch
description: Make follower(s) carry a torch in the dark, or put torches away.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow and Wait.

state.description: Torch, exactly one of: on, off.

prompt: If the player asks you to light or carry a torch, or to put your torch away, begin your response with '{key}:'
